n: Given July 9, 1841, at Brigham Young’s log home in Nauvoo, just after he returned from leading the Twelve’s mission to Britain. The Lord tenderly releases him from leaving his family as he had so often before—his sacrifice is accepted.

f.g: An unusually warm opening, written in Joseph Smith’s hand as he recorded the revelation.

f.w: your offering is acceptable to me

n: The Lord has seen all his labor and travels. Brigham had served many missions and had left his family sick and poor when he departed for England in 1839.
Brigham should now send the word abroad through others and take special care of his family from now on.

f.w: take especial care of your family
